question: Will The Odyssey gross more than Spider-Man: Brand New Day at the domestic box office this weekend (Sept 18–20)?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to actuals via The Numbers or Box Office Mojo
research:
I couldn't find any official weekend actuals published by the Sept 18 cutoff. Every source from before the cutoff has Spider-Man: Brand New Day ahead of The Odyssey by a small and shrinking margin. The two films are in their 8th and 10th weekends, both well under $10M.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on actuals from The Numbers or Box Office Mojo. The Sept 18-20 weekend chart pages exist ([The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/box-office-chart/weekend/2026/09/18), [Box Office Mojo](https://www.boxofficemojo.com/date/2026-09-18/)), but the proxy blocked every attempt to open them. Weekend actuals normally come out Monday, Sept 21.
- 2026-09-13: The Numbers' chart for Sept 11-13, as shown in search snippets: Spider-Man was 2nd with $935,181,631 total after 45 days, and The Odyssey was 3rd with $600,700,025 total. [The Numbers](https://www.the-numbers.com/box-office-chart/weekend/2026/09/11)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles it yet. As of the cutoff, Spider-Man has beaten The Odyssey every weekend since it opened, but the gap is down to about $1M and The Odyssey has been falling less each week.
- Some search results showed weekend figures dated after the cutoff. Per your instructions I ignored them.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-17 (approx.): Boxoffice Pro's weekend preview put Spider-Man at $4M-$6M and called the Spider-Man vs. Odyssey race "neck and neck." It gave Spider-Man the edge because it has a bigger share of showtimes. [Boxoffice Pro](https://www.boxofficepro.com/weekend-preview-resident-evil-set-to-swarm-cinemas-with-a-franchise-record/)
- 2026-09-17 (approx.): Box Office Report expected Resident Evil to open around $58.5M in 3,684 locations and Practical Magic 2 to fall about 61% to $11.8M. I couldn't read its Spider-Man or Odyssey numbers. [Box Office Report](http://www.boxofficereport.com/predictions/predictions20260917.html)
- 2026-09-18: Sony's Resident Evil opens and will likely take premium-format and IMAX screens. That matters more for The Odyssey, which depends heavily on IMAX. This is my inference, not something a source reported.
- 2026-09-11 to 13: Practical Magic 2 opened at #1 with about $30.0M, ending Spider-Man's six-weekend streak at #1. Spider-Man made $8.4M ($935.1M total) and The Odyssey $7.4M ($600.5M total). [Rotten Tomatoes](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/weekend-box-office-practical-magic-week-1/), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/09/box-office-practical-magic-2-weekend-1237098516/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/practical-magic-2-box-office-spider-man-domestic-record-1236698853/)
- 2026-09-06: For the Labor Day Fri-Sun, Spider-Man made about $18M in its 6th weekend and The Odyssey about $13M in its 8th. [MyNewsLA](https://mynewsla.com/hollywood/2026/09/06/spider-man-brand-new-day-the-odyssey-lead-weekend-box-office-2/)

## 4. Base rates and trend
These figures are reconstructed from news reports, not from the resolution source.

| Weekend | Spider-Man | The Odyssey | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aug 7-9 | $144.3M | $31.7M | +$112.6M SM |
| Aug 21-23 | $39.0M | $19.5M | +$19.5M SM |
| Sep 4-6 (Labor Day, Fri-Sun) | ~$18M | ~$13M | +~$5M SM |
| Sep 11-13 | $8.4M | $7.4M | +$1.0M SM |

- Sources: [Gold Derby](https://www.goldderby.com/film/2026/spider-man-brand-new-day-odyssey-box-office-one-night-only/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/box-office/box-office-spider-man-second-weekend-the-odyssey-1236830599/), [Rotten Tomatoes](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/weekend-box-office-spider-man-brand-new-day-week-4/), MyNewsLA and Rotten Tomatoes (both above).
- From Labor Day to Sept 11-13, Spider-Man fell about 53% and The Odyssey about 43%. The holiday inflated both Labor Day numbers.
- If those drop rates held, Spider-Man would land around $3.9M and The Odyssey around $4.2M, which would flip the order. A 5-10 point difference in either film's drop decides the outcome. This is arithmetic, not a forecast.
- Spider-Man has finished ahead every weekend so far, and the gap has shrunk sharply each time.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-17 (approx.): JoBlo predicted Spider-Man 3rd with $5.0M and The Odyssey 4th with $4.5M. [JoBlo](https://www.joblo.com/?p=947812)
- 2026-09-17 (approx.): Boxoffice Pro put Spider-Man at $4M-$6M, "neck and neck" with The Odyssey, with Spider-Man favored on showtime share. [Boxoffice Pro](https://www.boxofficepro.com/?p=45905)
- 2026-09-17: A Gold Derby preview reportedly projected The Odyssey at about $5M. I couldn't confirm its Spider-Man figure.
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold markets on this matchup.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-18 to 20: Resident Evil (wide) opens, and Practical Magic 2 has its second weekend. Both compete for screens.
- 2026-09-19: Friday estimates come out. Watch Deadline and Box Office Mojo daily charts.
- 2026-09-20: Sunday studio estimates come out. The two films could be within a few hundred thousand dollars of each other, so Monday's actuals could reverse the order of Sunday's estimates.
- 2026-09-21: Actuals are published on The Numbers and Box Office Mojo.
